sloka: न अत्यर्थम् अभिकान्क्षामि मृगयाम् सरयू वने ।रतिर् हि एषा अतुला लोके राज ऋषि गण सम्मता ॥२-४९-१६॥
transliteration: na atyartham abhikānkṣāmi mṛgayām sarayū vane ।ratir hi eṣā atulā loke rāja ṛṣi gaṇa sammatā ॥2-49-16॥

translations.english: In this world, hunting is a unique pleasure. It is regarded as a delightful sport for royal sages. But I do not have a great longing for hunting in the forest on the bank of river Sarayu.
translations.hindi: ये महाबाहु ओर शूर दशरथनन्दन अभी बहुत दूर नहीं गये होगे, अत: चलो हम सब श्रीरामचन्द्र जी के पास चल
